amber-flame.$description: Amber Flame — Logo, brand mark, gradient start — the warm orange anchors the entire identity as the only chromatic element on a monochrome canvas

honey-glow.$description: Honey Glow — Logo gradient end, warm highlight — lifts the amber into golden territory, visible in section headings and brand accents

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Primary CTA buttons, interactive links — cool blue against warm-amber brand creates intentional temperature contrast that separates identity from action

bright-blue.$description: Bright Blue — Hover/active state for blue CTAs, secondary interactive highlights

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary page background, card surfaces, hero sections

snow-gray.$description: Snow Gray — Alternating section backgrounds, subtle surface differentiation from white

pewter.$description: Pewter — Secondary body text, captions, muted labels

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Dark surface backgrounds in dark sections

ink.$description: Ink — Primary heading and body text color

true-black.$description: True Black — Maximum contrast text, nav links, icon color

vivid-green.$description: Vivid Green — Feature category indicator, privacy/security highlights

electric-magenta.$description: Electric Magenta — Feature category indicator, collaboration highlights

alert-red.$description: Alert Red — Feature category indicator, emphasis highlights

system-ui.$description: Primary typeface for all content — headlines, body, subheadings. Using the system font stack is a deliberate choice that makes the app feel native to macOS/iOS, reinforcing the clipboard-manager-as-OS-extension identity. Weight 400 for body, 600-700 for headlines.

inter.$description: Used for press/media logos section labels — small metadata text where system-ui's metrics may not be optimal
